protocol:
Red Blood Cell Lysis Protocol: Method II. 
Dilute the 10X RBC Lysis Buffer to 1X working concentration with deionized water.
Warm the 1X solution to room temperature prior to use.
Add 2.0 ml of 1X RBC Lysis Buffer to each tube containing up to 100 μl of whole blood.
Gently vortex each tube immediately after adding the lysing solution.
Incubate at room temperature, protected from light, for 10-15 minutes.
Centrifuge 350 x g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant without disturbing pellet, and resuspend the pellet in the appropriate buffer (e.g., BioLegendCell Staining Buffer, Cat. No. 420201)

parameters.container: tube containing up to 100 μl whole blood

parameters.reagent: appropriate buffer (e.g., BioLegend Cell Staining Buffer, Cat. No. 420201)

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dilute(reagent='10X RBC Lysis Buffer', diluent='deionized water', final_concentration='1X')
warm(reagent='1X RBC Lysis Buffer', temperature='room temperature', prior_to_use=True)
add(container='tube containing up to 100 μl whole blood', reagent='1X RBC Lysis Buffer', volume='2.0 ml')
vortex(container='each tube', speed='gentle', timing='immediately after adding lysing solution')
incubate(container='tube', temperature='room temperature', duration='10-15 minutes', protected_from_light=True)
centrifuge(container='tube', duration='5 minutes', speed='350 x g')
aspirate(container='tube', reagent='supernatant', without_disturbing_pellet=True)
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='appropriate buffer (e.g., BioLegend Cell Staining Buffer, Cat. No. 420201)', target='pellet')
